note: extract_features.py heuristic misfired on this small single-context app (parsed GRAPH_REPORT prose); features refined manually from module docs per assess Step 3.

features.name: catalog-item-management
features.capability: Browse, view, create, edit, and delete catalog products (CRUD admin UI with pagination and validation).

features.name: reference-data-brands-types
features.capability: Read catalog brands and types, expose them via Web API (api/Brands, api/Files), populate UI dropdowns.

features.name: product-imagery
features.capability: Serve catalog item pictures over HTTP and import picture sets during seeding.

features.name: data-seeding-init
features.capability: Create the catalog database, run SQL sequences, and seed types/brands/items from hardcoded data or CSV/ZIP files.

features.name: application-platform
features.capability: Hosting, dependency injection, routing, configuration, logging, and telemetry that all features depend on.

reference_target.name: eShopPorted
reference_target.note: In-repo ASP.NET Core 2.2 + EF Core port of the same context; concrete target-architecture reference for the migration.
